About this gig

Automate Your Business with AI-Powered Workflows

Manual work slows growth. We build AI automation workflows using n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, and Make that eliminate repetitive tasks, connect your tools, and scale your operations without extra hires.


What We Can Automate for You

  • AI Automation & AI Agents: GPT-powered chat, lead qualification, support flows, and smart decision-making
  • Claude Automation: Cowork, Routine, Claude Automation
  • Hermes AI, Openclaw, autonomous agent
  • n8n, Zapier & Make Workflows: Custom automations built exactly for your business logic
  • CRM & Lead Automation: Lead capture, enrichment, routing, follow-ups, and pipeline sync
  • API & Webhook Integrations: REST / Webhooks / Custom APIs for advanced use cases
  • Email, Sheets & Tools Automation: Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Airtable & more



Why Work With US:

  • AI-native automation mindset
  • Clean, scalable workflow architecture
  • Clear communication & fast delivery
  • Support until everything runs smoothly

No templates. No guesswork. Just automation that actually works.

CoreMemories — AI-Powered Living Legacy Platform

Overview CoreMemories is a next-generation legacy-preservation platform that transforms personal stories into living conversations. Using Conversational Memory AI and a secure Memory Vault, individuals can preserve their voice, wisdom, and presence, ensuring loved ones stay connected across generations. Kcube AI developed CoreMemories, a platform blending AI voice replication, conversational intelligence, and multimedia enrichment into one seamless system. Key Features Conversational Memory AI — interactive conversations with loved ones’ authentic voices. Memory Vault — private, encrypted repository for memories, recordings, and media. AI Voice Replication — captures unique tone, personality, and laughter. Family Collaboration — relatives can co-build legacies with prompts & shared memories. Multimedia Enrichment — add photos, videos, and social content. Flexible Plans — individual, family, and extended family tiers.
